title: Tim Taylor converts to Catholicism at the Vatican

tellings.quote: Tim Taylor had a conversion right at the Vatican where he converted to Catholicism.

plain: A man named Timothy Taylor, the subject of an episode about a man NASA is said to study because he seems to attract UFOs, is said to have converted to Catholicism right at the Vatican. Michels mentions it himself, without giving a source or a date. It is one detail of a life Michels presents as touched by both UFOs and religion.
